verdict.rationale: The official Go SDK documents CreateWithContext (charge-bearing domain registration) plus CheckWithContext and RenewWithContext, showing a real, documented API path for purchasing domains programmatically, and the API/sandbox endpoints exist for scripting. However, the evidence never documents contact-information parameters or nameserver-setting calls as part of the registration flow, so the full 'purchase + contacts + nameservers' deploy-script story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: documented contact fields for registration calls, documented nameserver-setting calls tied to registration, and an end-to-end example script combining all three steps.
